title: Vault of Surreal Dreams
description: A young woman in a white tank top and shorts stands on a glowing chessboard, holding a selfie stick that emits a bright yellow beam into an open massive circular vault door decorated with a giant red flower. The scene is surrounded by floating framed portraits, thorny roses, and floating faces against a twilight sky.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a young woman with dark hair in a white crop top and shorts standing on a glowing yellow chessboard. She holds a selfie stick pointed into a giant open circular vault door that has a large red flower design on it. The beam from the stick shoots into a starry void inside the vault. Surrounding the scene are floating ornate picture frames with faces, thorny roses, vines, and disembodied floating faces against a twilight sky with purple and blue tones.
